layers.names: every file of the 24 listings, by its name only; nothing opened
layers.structure: sample files opened for their headers, keys or labels (spec/raw_columns.json)
layers.archive_directories: central directories of a sample of zip archives read by byte ranges (pipeline/zip_directory.py); no archive downloaded
layers.values: values read in full from two groups of files (data/pipeline/raw_values.csv)

levels.test: tied to a test by name
levels.day_or_session: tied to a day or session by name

_meta.units: bytes as the PSI listing reports them
_meta.archive_sample: A sample: directories of 23 archives chosen by size class and name pattern (3 by size, then the median-size archive of the 20 largest name-pattern groups); member names were read, members were not opened.

sentences: A tie by name means that the name carries the identifier of that test (or day), equal to a cell of the experimental table; the content of the file was not checked.
Of 60866 listed files, 12934 are tied to a test by name, 30595 to a day or session, and 17337 are not tied.
219 sample files were opened for their headers, keys or labels; one file of a group does not show what the other files of the group hold.
15 files were read in full for values (raw_values.csv); no value of a raw file is used by the pipeline.
The directory of 23 of 12689 archives was read by byte ranges without downloading them (4401457 bytes fetched for 52471079132 bytes of archives); the member names are a sample.
The rank of data/pipeline/retrieval_queue.csv is a fixed ordering rule (tests lacking the value, descending, then bytes of the group, ascending); it is not a priority set by the team or by NASA.
None of these layers says that a file holds a quantity, nor whether its values are complete or calibrated.
